summary: EDMONTON, Alberta and SAN DIEGO, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TSX, NYSE:STN Stantec, a global leader in sustainable design and engineering, has been selected by the City of San Diego for a 10-year, US$75 million capacity engineering and construction services contract that will help strengthen and modernize 11 dams serving more than 1.3 million residents across the region. Under the contract, Stantec will provide engineering, environmental, design, and construction support services for long-term improvement projects across multiple state-regulated dams.
title: Stantec selected to help modernize San Diego's critical water infrastructure for generations to come
